designationHistory.indexText: The Navy transferred management of all of Nomans Land Island, a former bombing range off Martha's Vineyard, to the Fish and Wildlife Service in 1998 to become a national wildlife refuge.

authority.citation: Transfer of management responsibility from the U.S. Navy

designationHistory.note: FWS had managed the eastern third under a joint agreement with the Navy since 1970; the full transfer came in 1998.

sources.name: FWS ServCat: Nomans Land Island NWR Comprehensive Conservation Plan (2010)
